display_long_description:
# 🍕 WELCOME TO THE WORST FOOD TRUCK EVER! 🐀
Your food truck is a mess. Your customers are questionable. Your recipes are… technically food. But if you can follow their orders, serve the right dishes, and make some money, you might just turn this filthy truck into a thriving business!

[media]

# 👨‍🍳 SERVE. EARN. UPGRADE.

Follow the rat’s instructions through a brand-new onboarding and learn how to run your chaotic food truck. Carefully prepare what your customers ask for, serve them before they lose patience, and earn money with every successful order.


[media]

# 💰 BUILD YOUR FOOD TRUCK EMPIRE

Spend your hard-earned cash at the shop behind you! Unlock upgrades, improve your setup, and find new ways to make more money. The better you serve, the more you can unlock.

[media]

# 🌭 MORE THAN JUST PIZZA
Unlock new machines and expand your menu with sides and drinks:

- Hot Dog Machine
- Slushie Machine
- Drinks Fridge

Give your customers exactly what they ordered and make a little extra cash with every sale.

🔪 UNLOCK CHAOTIC TOOLS

Get more than 12 crazy tools from the shop, including weapons and familiar items from our other games. Spot the references, experiment with them, and let the chaos begin.
Want to deal with a difficult customer? There are… creative ways to handle that.

👀 MEET YOUR CUSTOMERS

The customers have never looked this expressive! With a brand-new character art direction, they’re more expressive, reactive, and ready to cause trouble than ever.

🍕 COOK. SERVE. UPGRADE. CAUSE CHAOS!!
